coverage.title: What this board covers
coverage.body: {marksName} are not in Wargaming’s public API, so we read them from the game portal one account at a time. This board ranks the {measured} accounts whose garage we have read, out of {tracked} that clear the battle floor: a player nobody has searched for is missing from it rather than last on it.
coverage.freshness: The newest observation behind these counts is from {newest}, the oldest from {oldest}.
coverage.profile: The players shown in each ranking are read again within the hour after they play, so the top of the board follows the game. Further down, a garage is read when someone opens that profile, which is also what puts a new player on this board. Hover a count to see when it was read.
